SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

3. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   D. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

7. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   C. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain School and Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Beef Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
